title: Sky Hop
brief: Climb five ledges with left/right drag and a jump button, dodging two spikes, to touch the goal flag at the top; three lives.

title: Cloud Climb
brief: Swipe up to jump between clouds (one drifts sideways) and collect five coins to win; falling past the bottom costs one of two lives.

title: Spring Tower
brief: Bounce up a tall tower on springs and ledges, avoiding a patrolling bat, to reach the crown goal; three lives.

title: Spike Run
brief: Run and jump across a wide scrolling world with pits and spikes to reach the finish line; three lives.

title: Lava Ledges
brief: Jump up eight ledges with three jump buttons while lava rises below; reach the star at the top, two lives.

title: Coin Canyon
brief: Hop across a scrolling canyon on rocks and a lift, collecting six coins to win; falling in the abyss costs a life.

title: Bounce Garden
brief: A frog bounces on pink pads and branches to pick four flowers while avoiding a bug and a beetle; three lives.

title: Moving Bridge
brief: Ride moving rafts and logs across a wide river past a fish to the flag on the far shore; falling in costs one of three lives.

title: Ghost Hill
brief: Climb a tall scrolling hill by swiping up, dodging two ghosts and lighting four candles to win; three lives.

title: Tower of Trials
brief: Three levels: climb to a door, pass spikes using a spring, then ride moving platforms past a wisp to the crown goal; four lives.
